evidenceOverview.smallSample: This is a small-sample observation. Read per-question denominators carefully; it is not a formal baseline.
evidenceOverview.emptyBody: There are no eligible answers in this scope. Start monitoring or ingest evidence first. No fabricated scores are shown.
evidenceOverview.metricNa: Denominator is 0 (N/A). Collect more samples or finish labels before reviewing.
evidenceOverview.officialNa: No official website on file; official-site citation is not applicable.
evidenceOverview.question: Question
evidenceOverview.suggestionsEmpty: No optimization suggestions yet. Generate diagnostics from answer evidence or collect more samples.
evidenceOverview.emptyAnswers: No answers match the current filters.

optimization.title: Optimization tasks
optimization.description: Turn answer and page evidence into a few retestable actions—no generic SEO lists.
optimization.noBrand: Create a brand profile before viewing optimization tasks.
optimization.empty: No open optimization tasks. Generate from the evidence overview or run a public page check first.
optimization.checkPagesHint: Up to 5 URLs per run. A fixture body stays offline. An empty fixture uses a read-only request only when public fetch is enabled on the server; otherwise the check stays closed. Publish or permission instructions are marked and never executed, and checks do not claim indexing.
optimization.NOT_FOUND: Resource not found or not accessible.

content.title: Content plans and drafts
content.description: Confirm briefs, then fill isolated templates into fact-bound drafts for review—no paid model calls.
content.mockContentNote: Functional mock walks the existing draft, review and export path with an approved mock fact. The labeling profile is marked functional-mock. Export is not publication and not real acceptance.
content.applyMockContent: Generate and export a mock draft
content.mockContentDone: The mock draft was reviewed and exported. This is not real generation or publication.
content.mockContentFailed: The mock draft did not finish. Write a mock fact first.
content.applyMockPublication: Check publication against a mock page
content.mockPublicationDone: The check used an in-memory synthetic page. No real site was fetched, and this is not a live publication.
content.mockPublicationFailed: The mock publication check did not finish. Export a mock draft first.
content.noBrand: Create a brand profile before managing content.
content.empty: No briefs yet. Add audience, gap, applicable boundary, and usable facts first.
content.plansEmpty: No content plans yet. Save a brief with a question cluster to create one.
content.titles: Title candidates (one per line, up to 3)
content.fixtureFailBriefs: Isolated brief IDs to fail (optional, one per line)
content.NOT_FOUND: Resource not found or not accessible.
content.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Evidence gaps remain (source, boundary, or related fields).
content.versionsEmpty: No content versions yet. Confirm a brief and generate drafts first.
content.approvalStale: Current content differs from the approved fingerprint; review again.
content.approvalCurrent: The approval still matches the current content.
content.variantHint: Changing title, body, images, channel or labeling voids an existing approval and requires a new review.
content.assetFileHint: Optional. JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 10 MiB. Without a file, only the content reference is saved.
content.ASSET_TYPE_REJECTED: This image type is not allowed. Use JPEG, PNG, or WebP and register it again.
content.ASSET_TOO_LARGE: This image is over 10 MiB. Compress it to 10 MiB or less and register it again.
content.ASSET_UNREVIEWED: This image has not been approved. Finish review before including it in a formal package.
content.exportHint: Exporting is not publishing. Unverified labeling only yields review packages marked non-publishable.
content.readOnly: This brand is archived and read-only.
content.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: An approval matching the current content is required before a formal package.
content.FACT_INVALID: A bound fact is revoked, expired, or not public.
content.LABELING_UNVERIFIED: Labeling profile is unverified; only non-publishable review packages can be exported.
content.SUBSET_INVALID: The chosen versions must be a subset that passed preflight.
content.APPROVAL_INVALID: The approval fingerprint does not match the current content, or no valid approval exists.
content.PUBLICATION_CONFLICT: This publication status does not allow that action.
content.publicationHint: After you publish externally, backfill the URL and verify with an isolated page, an enabled read-only fetch, or manual evidence. Export is not publication.
content.fixtureHint: Leave the box unchecked to submit an isolated page observation. When checked, the saved public URL is fetched read-only, without login state. HTTP success alone is not public verification.
content.useLiveFetch: Fetch the saved public URL read-only (ignore the isolated fields below)
content.liveFetchEnabled: Public fetch is enabled. Login walls are not bypassed; use manual evidence for restricted pages.
content.liveFetchDisabled: Public fetch is off. Checking the box records a closed result and does not access the network.
content.manualEvidenceHint: For login walls and restricted pages. Results are verified_manual and never pretend to be anonymous public success.

reports.title: Retest & reports
reports.description: Compare before/after windows on a shared scope and download immutable HTML/JSON snapshots. Exploratory conclusions do not claim causality.
reports.noBrand: Select a brand before opening retest and reports.
reports.noAutoCharge: In-app reminders never auto-charge paid runs
reports.SESSION_REQUIRED: Sign in to access retest and reports.
reports.FORBIDDEN: This request origin is not allowed.
reports.NOT_FOUND: Brand or report resource was not found.
reports.WINDOW_NOT_DUE: The observation window is not due yet; only progress is available.
reports.LOOP_NOT_READY: A verified effective time is required before creating a business-loop D+7 todo.
reports.mockRetestNote: Functional mock compares two windows of three same-scope synthetic samples and stores an immutable snapshot. The numbers are not monitoring and do not complete a business loop.
reports.mockRetestDone: A labeled synthetic snapshot was stored. This is not a real before/after sample.
reports.mockRetestFailed: The mock retest did not finish.
reports.mockGateNote: This calls the existing gate function. The inputs are labeled zeros, not pilot counts, and the result is not acceptance.
reports.mockGateInputs: Real brand: no. Official answers: 0. Consumer answers: 0. Independent completions: 0.
reports.mockGatePassed: The function returned pass. That is still not stage acceptance.
reports.mockGateContract: The function thresholds are unchanged. The product contract still requires five real walkthrough users. T-M0-GATE stays unchecked.

competitorAnalysis.title: Competitors and sources
competitorAnalysis.description: Counts only recorded mentions and observed citations. Share is not a rank, and this page does not fetch external pages.
competitorAnalysis.noBrand: Create a brand before reviewing competitors and sources.
competitorAnalysis.setsEmpty: No competitor set yet. Save 0–5 names. A different list starts a new version.
competitorAnalysis.labels: Competitor names (one per line, up to 5)
competitorAnalysis.unordered: These mentions have no explicit order, so no rank is shown.
competitorAnalysis.absent: Absent and excluded from the mean: {names}
competitorAnalysis.unorderedExcluded: {count} unordered mentions stay out of the rank.
competitorAnalysis.truncated: Too many mentions to calculate a share. An incomplete number is not shown.
competitorAnalysis.noObservations: There is no answer to attach, or no competitor set yet. Save an answer and a set first.
competitorAnalysis.ordered: This answer is an ordered recommendation
competitorAnalysis.hosts: Domain occurrences, not a platform preference
competitorAnalysis.copied: This only swaps the other brand name for ours, so it was not saved.
competitorAnalysis.missingEvidence: A gap or an observed source from this brand is missing, so it was not saved.
competitorAnalysis.NOT_FOUND: The resource was not found or is not yours.
competitorAnalysis.OPERATION_CONFLICT: This action conflicts with the current state.
